_why: From a bench machine on 2026-11-07 (Linux test deb under Xvfb, signed in to a real server, settled profile), with a margin for run-to-run spread:
startMedianMs: first mail row 3906 ms median over 24 cold starts (p75 4030); about 25 % over.
shellMedianMs: start to the page's navigation 999 ms median (p75 1030); about 30 % over.
idlePssMb: all processes 520 MB after five idle minutes; about 30 % over.
idleWakeupsPerMinute: voluntary context switches of all threads, 500 a minute over a 120 s window (1000 in 120 s); about 30 % over.
A runner slower than that machine needs these raised in step, never a lone retry.
